_comment: GamingOptimizer user-tunable settings. Edit and re-run GamingOptimizer.ps1.
_EnableHAGS_help: Enable Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling. Requires Win11 + WDDM 2.7 driver. Disable if you experience instability.
_DisablePowerThrottling_help: Prevent Windows from throttling CPU frequency for background work.
_DisableVisualEffects_help: Disable desktop animations and transparency for reduced GPU overhead.
_NetworkOptimizations_help: Disable Nagle algorithm and set multimedia network-throttling index.
_StopNonEssentialServices_help: Temporarily stop background services like SysMain, Windows Search, etc.
_BoostLauncherPriorities_help: Raise game-launcher process priority to AboveNormal.
_MmcssGamingProfile_help: Configure the Windows MMCSS Games scheduling profile.
_GameMode_help: Enable Windows 11 Game Mode (concentrates CPU/GPU resources on the game).
_FullscreenOptimizations_help: Optimize Game DVR and Fullscreen Exclusive behaviour.
_PowerPlan_help: Power plan to activate: 'UltimatePerformance' (default), 'HighPerformance', or a custom GUID.
_AutoRestoreAtLogon_help: Disabled: this system is a permanent gaming console. Restore is not available.
_StateFileDir_help: Override directory for the state snapshot file. Leave empty to use %ProgramData%\GamingOptimizer.
